card.name: Heredity and birth defect context
card.fires_on: Small linking words, punctuation or digits right before an expected genetic or congenital term (inherited, mutations, malformations, MIDD). Seen in text on birth defects, inherited mitochondrial disease and DNA changes passed to children.
